name: ASK Automotive Limited
summary: ASK Automotive Limited, founded in 1988 and headquartered in Gurugram, makes and distributes automotive components in India through its subsidiary. Its products include braking systems such as brake shoes, disc pads and liners, and lightweight aluminum precision parts for two-wheelers, four-wheelers and electric vehicles. It also produces safety control cables, including brake, clutch and throttle cables.
